brother idk if what I'm doing takes being smart

I've literally just buying the same coin every single day for months and sitting on it because I believe in a few things

1) robinhood chain going up and still being early (they've literally only listed two eco coins)

2) cats are the dogs of this cycle because vlad likes cats... there are two dominant cat coins on RH & one of them is significantly cheaper than the other & also the leading coin of the leading launchpad on Robinhood

3) once something proliferates itself enough early on, the coin becomes part of the lore of the chain itself... as the chain grows, it does the work for your bags

4) not overtrading... have I missed some narratives over the last week or two? yes - but have I managed to avoid being chopped to shreds by buying something that slowly rugs while watching the bag I believe in slowly grind higher? also yes

5) kind of an additional point to 4 is that by rotating in and out of too many positions early on, you also diffuse both your own capital and others. Concentrated capital in a high conviction bag is how you win

so there are some days I look like a genius and other days I look like a dumbass depending on what the price does

but I'm just sticking the plan and trusting the process
